entities.text: Vallamkondu Ramanaiah vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Author: U. Durga Prasad Rao
Bench: U. Durga Prasad Rao
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice U. Durga Prasad Rao
 Criminal Petition No.5146 Of 2019
Order:

The petitioners/A1 and A2 seek to quash the proceedings against them in P.R.C.No.39 of 2019 on the file of learned Junior Civil Judge - cum - First Additional Judicial Magistrate of First Class,
Badvel, which was taken cognizance under Sections 188, 272, 273 and 328 of IPC and Sections 57 and 58 r/w 26, 30 of Food Safety and Standards Act (for short, 'FSS Act').
2.

entities.text:
Junior Civil Judge - cum - First Additional Judicial Magistrate of First Class,
Badvel
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The allegations against the petitioners briefly are that on 04.07.2019 at 08.30 p.m., when the complainant along with his staff conducting a vehicle check at Rajupalem Bus Stop on Badvel - Siddavaram road, seized auto bearing No.AP 04UB 1362 and on enquiry, the accused revealed that they have been involved in selling of banned tobacco products for earning money, under the cover of mediator's report and registered the same as a case in Crime No.118 of 2019 for the offences stated supra.
3. Learned counsel for petitioners while denying the FIR allegations would submit that even if the prosecution case is accepted to be true, tobacco products would not fall within the definition of Section 3(j) of FSS Act and therefore, the Police are not authorized to register the crime, investigate and file charge sheet and therefore, registration of the FIR is contrary to the provisions of FSS Act.
He relied upon the order of this Court in Crl.P.Nos.3731 of 2018 and batch, dated 27.08.2018.
As can be seen, in the said common order a learned Judge of this Court partly allowed the criminal petitions and quashed the offences punishable under Indian Penal Code and FSS Act.

4. So far as the offence under Section 188 of IPC is concerned, as per Section 195(1)(a)(i) of Cr.P.C,
no Court shall take cognizance of the said offence except on the complaint in writing of that Court or by such Officer of the Court as that Court may authorise in writing in this behalf, or of some other Court to which that Court is subordinate.
However, in the instant case, the F.I.R is registered suo moto basing on the report of the Sub-Inspector of Police of Badvel Rural Police Station.

entities.text: Police of Badvel Rural Police Station
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
Therefore, it is the violation of Section 195 of Cr.P.C so far as the Section 188 of IPC is concerned and therefore,
the said offence is also liable to be quashed.

5. Following the above order and for the reasons recorded therein, this criminal petition is allowed and the proceedings initiated against the petitioners under Sections 188, 272, 273 and 328 of IPC and Sections 57 and 58 r/w 26, 30 of Food Safety and Standards Act (for short, 'FSS Act') are hereby Vallamkondu Ramanaiah vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 11 September, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/104921595/
1 quashed.
